mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary cycle, compressing discount rates applied to equity cash flows, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns not significantly positive (p > 0.05 in t-test) despite a sustained FEDFUNDS decline over 3 months.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the federal funds rate above 1.5% in the next month triggers negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days, reflecting higher borrowing costs.
failure_condition: 20-day returns not significantly negative (p > 0.05 in t-test) despite FEDFUNDS exceeding 1.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in both demand (GDPC1) and supply (INDPRO) indices signals robust economic growth, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 and INDPRO both rise in the same month
failure_condition: 20-day returns not significantly positive (p > 0.05 in t-test) despite simultaneous GDPC1 and INDPRO increases.

mechanism_narrative: During a late-cycle expansion, a sustained decline in the federal funds rate predicts positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as investors anticipate lower future rates.
failure_condition: 20-day returns not significantly positive (p > 0.05 in t-test) during a late-cycle expansion despite FEDFUNDS decline.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly CPIAUCSL index exceeding 230 triggers negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days, reflecting concerns about overheating inflation.
failure_condition: 20-day returns not significantly negative (p > 0.05 in t-test) despite CPIAUCSL exceeding 230.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly UNRATE falling below 7.5% predicts positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days, signaling improved labor market conditions and reduced recession risks.
failure_condition: 20-day returns not significantly positive (p > 0.05 in t-test) despite UNRATE falling below 7.5%.

mechanism_narrative: An INDPRO index exceeding 98 in the next month triggers positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days, indicating robust supply-side growth and market optimism.
failure_condition: 20-day returns not significantly positive (p > 0.05 in t-test) despite INDPRO exceeding 98.

mechanism_narrative: Both labor demand (PAYEMS) and monetary easing (FEDFUNDS) rising in the same month trigger positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days, signaling strong employment growth and accommodative policy.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS and FEDFUNDS both rise in the same month
regime_hint: expansive labor market and policy accommodation
failure_condition: 20-day returns not significantly positive (p > 0.05 in t-test) despite simultaneous PAYEMS and FEDFUNDS increases.
